name: Kadın kahraman
description: A young Hun woman warrior archer of about twenty, heroic and kind, the female counterpart of the warrior in the reference: long dark hair in two thick braids with small bronze beads, a red felt headband, a crimson felt riding coat with a fur-trimmed collar and red Greek-key borders over a beige tunic, a dark leather lamellar vest, a red sash with round bronze belt plates, leather bracers, dark trousers and tall brown leather boots.
